notes: Hythloth is the permanent Hot dungeon, so its drops are the most hellish pieces in the catalog: two daemon figures, the Blood Pentagram, the dungeon arch the catalog tags 'dungeon:hythloth', demon faces, a blood altar and a skull wreathed in fire. 'tier' is the catalog tier and can be used directly as drop rarity (five extremely-rare, so the top end is always a daemon or a hell-gate piece). 'theme' groups the pieces so a daemon corpse can roll daemon items and a chest can roll rite items. One piece (CR-CUR-019) is era grade C: kept because nothing else in the catalog reads as hellfire this clearly. Hythloth is not a Wanted destination, so none of these overlap the curator pools.

entries.why: Towering daemon colossus, the showpiece of the pool
Obsidian daemon, black glass and menace
Blood-red pentagram, the mark a daemon is called by
Mossy dungeon arch, the catalog's own Hythloth-tagged gate
Skull wreathed in fire; grade C but nothing else says hellfire so well
Pentagram altar ringed with skull candles, ready for a rite
Summoning circle with its corner skulls and candles
Black obsidian pentagram, cold and unlit
Row of three stone demon faces glaring from the wall line
Jade demon face, a green horned grimace
A single grey stone demon face, the humbler trophy of the set
